facts.fact: Chez 凑到她脸边喊她醒来——她在阳光洒进来的卧室里睁开眼。
facts.anchor: Chez’s purple eyes were leaning close to my face. “Wakey, wakey.”

facts.fact: Duchess 摇着扇子开口先抱怨：他们到河这边整整两天，竟没想到先来拜访她。
facts.anchor: You lot have been on this side of the river for all of two days, and you did not think to visit me first?

facts.fact: 她把线索拼齐：把她和 Rabb 从冰水坟场里救出来的，正是 Duchess。
facts.anchor: The Duchess must have been the one who’d saved Rabb and me from our ice water grave.

facts.fact: 国王从墙边扑上猛推 Gregory 的胸口，吼出「你们丢下我们去死」。
facts.anchor: He shoved Gregory’s chest—hard. “You left us to die!”

facts.fact: Gregory 顶回去：国王打从进门起就四处找敌人，没有也要造出敌人来。
facts.anchor: From the moment you arrived, you have been seeking enemies and seeming determined to invent them.

facts.fact: 决斗赌注：Gregory 若胜，国王退回河对岸永不回来。
facts.anchor: “If I win, you must go back to your side of the river and never return.”

facts.fact: Gregory 抱定赴死的觉悟，那记死亡却没有落下；他几乎想再拾剑，随后神色松开，决斗的真实结局落了地。
facts.anchor: steeled himself for a painful death that did not come. His shoulders were still heaving. His eyes flickered as if he almost wanted to take up his sword once again, but then his expression cleared.

facts.fact: 临别时 Sophie 的目光落在她身上，称她「来自另一个世界的夫人」。
facts.anchor: But Sophie was looking at me. “My lady, from another world.”
